create_transform3d: create a Transform3d object to apply 3D transformations on batched point clouds
build_translate_transform: build a Translate transform to shift 3D points by specified x, y, z offsets
compose_transforms: compose multiple Transform3d objects into a single chained transformation
transform_points: transform a batch of 3D points through a Transform3d with homogeneous coordinate handling
rotate_axis_angle: rotate 3D points about a named axis by an angle in degrees or radians
